lines.rom: jayati jayati jaga nivasa samkara sukhakari
ajara amara aja arupa sata cita anandarupa vyapaka brahmasvarupa bhava bhava bhaya hari
sobhita bidhubala bhala surasarimaya jatajala tina nayana ati visala madana dahana kari
bhaktahetu dharata sula karata kathina sula phula hiyaki saba harata hula acala santikari
amala aruna carana kamala saphala karata kama sakala bhakti mukti deta vimala maya bhrama tari
kartikeyayuta ganesa himatanaya saha mahesa rajata kailasa desa akala kaladhari

kartikeyayuta ganesa himatanaya saha mahesa rajata kailasa desa akala kaladhari
bhusana tana bhuti byala mundamala kara kapala simha carma hasti khala damaru kara dhari
asarana jana nitya sarana asutosa artiharana saba bidhi kalyana karana jaya jaya tripurari
